name: rp2350
comment: The RP2350: two Cortex-M33 cores with a RISC-V hazard3 core, 520 KB of SRAM and no on-chip flash. Executable code is read from an external flash chip through the XIP cache, so a program is linked at its XIP address and copied there by the bootrom.
comment_linker: The linker script, the memory map and the startup are the SDK's, through the board's prelude: an RP2350 image needs the vendor's boot block and crt0, and a second copy of either is a second thing to keep in step with the silicon.

toolchain.comment: the compiler is named so CMake has one before `project()`; the prelude locates the SDK and defines its targets, and the flags and linker come from those

flash.comment: the bootrom's own protocol over USB; hold BOOTSEL while powering the board
